title: Ruleset: item_use
description: rules/<id>/item_use.yaml: how the partner takes the items the tamer gives it (apps/session: ItemUseRules, apps/session/README.md).

from.description: The first item of the range.

to.description: The last item of the range, not before from.

refusal.description: Which items the partner refuses (partner_impl.c: partnerWillRefuseItem).

discipline_checked_below.description: Items with a lower number go through the discipline roll.

fixed_level_evolutions.description: Evolution items it takes only at one level.

refused_level_differences.description: The other evolution items are refused when the target's level minus the partner's is one of these.

meals.description: The items that answer hunger (partner_impl.c: partnerHandleFoodFeed).

shop_discount_levels.description: The partner levels of data/digimon that get the shops' baby discount (script_common.c: isPartnerBaby).

training_boost_bits.description: The bit of each stat in a food's training boost flag (trn_reward.c).
